description_en: Invoke ListChatRecordDetail to query online session details by time period.
description_zh: 调用ListChatRecordDetail根据时间段查询在线会话详情

parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成

parameters.help_en: Right boundary of the time range for session end time. Format: UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: close_time_end

parameters.help_en: Left boundary of the time range for session end time. Format: UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
